text:
Maya: Drafted a 1‑pager for the enterprise launch — focus: security, SLA guarantees, and deploy modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Posting here for quick feedback on the messaging, benchmark callouts, webinar hook, and inbound routing plan. :rocket:
Omar: Nice — can you drop the current draft link? want to see the flow and headline metrics.
Maya: https://drive.redwood/enterprise-briefs/launch-slate-v1.pdf — TL;DR: two-sided hero: "Secure, predictable LLM inference" plus a small benchmark: p99 latency 85ms on Dedicated (4x cheaper ops vs naive hosting) — still rough numbers.
Sam: Benchmarks need source callouts. which model / seq length / batching? ops will question the 4x number without specifics.
Maya: Good point. draft note currently: "Internal benchmark: 33% lower token cost with caching + burst routing; 4x throughput improvements on Dedicated vs single-host run for batch workloads (see appendix)." We can make that a small visual.
Liz: Messaging: lead with compliance and predictable economics for enterprise buyers. Hero bullets: SLA-backed latency, VPC/private option, KMS support, and migration playbooks. Quick customer quote placeholder: "We got consistent 20ms tail improvements and saved 35% on inference costs."
Omar: For webinar narrative: quick 20min demo (deployment modes + console), 15min benchmarks & cost story, 15min Q&A. CTA: sign up for a Dedicated pilot or request a security review.
Sam: Inbound routing suggestion from ops: route webinar registrants with "security" in company field to EPD queue; otherwise to AM. If ARR > $250k route to AE team. Also tag with "pilot_interest".
Clara (OpsBot): Suggested routing rule snippet:
```
if company_size == "enterprise" and mentions_compliance:
  route = "security-epd"
elif ARR_estimate > 250000:
  route = "AE-priority"
else:
  route = "AM-nurture"
```
Maya: Love that. For the one‑pager visuals: propose 3 panels — value props, benchmark strip (latency/cost), deploy modes matrix with bullets per mode. Add a tiny section on rollouts & fallbacks.
Liz: Also add a one-sentence risk/mitigation box: "fallback plan: automatic variant routing + canary rollouts reduce failure blast radius" — helps procurement/security folks.
Omar: Who owns final assets? Maya: I'll iterate and send a v2 by EOD Wed. Sam: ops needs the benchmark appendix (raw numbers + config) by Tue for accuracy. Liz: I'll draft the webinar microcopy and email cadence (3-email drip).
Maya: Great — owners: Maya (one‑pager + design), Liz (webinar copy + emails), Sam (benchmark appendix), Omar (field enablement slides). Can everyone ack by EOD Mon? :email:
Omar: Ack.
Sam: Ack — will get raw logs to you Tue morning.
Liz: Ack — drafting email sequence now.
Maya: Thanks — I'll post v2 link here when ready and tag legal for compliance checks.
